entities.summary: Caroline de Oliveira Saad Gattaz, better known as Carol Gattaz, is a Brazilian volleyball player. She competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics, in the Women's tournament, winning a silver medal. Gattaz won the World Grand Prix three times in a row.
